sentences.fr: Hier, j’avais mal à la tête toute la journée.
sentences.en: Yesterday I had a headache all day.
distractors: Yesterday I had a stomach ache all day.
Today I have a headache all day.
Yesterday I had a headache all morning.

gloss.en: pain (avoir mal à la tête = to have a headache)

sentences.fr: Le médecin m’a donné une ordonnance pour trois médicaments.
sentences.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for three medicines.
distractors: The doctor gave me a prescription for two medicines.
The pharmacist gave me a prescription for three medicines.
The doctor showed me a prescription for three medicines.

sentences.fr: J’ai pris rendez-vous chez le dentiste pour mardi prochain.
sentences.en: I made an appointment with the dentist for next Tuesday.
distractors: I made an appointment with the doctor for next Tuesday.
I made an appointment with the dentist for last Tuesday.
I made an appointment with the dentist for next Thursday.

gloss.en: at the office of; at the home of

sentences.fr: Elle est restée au lit parce qu’elle avait de la fièvre.
sentences.en: She stayed in bed because she had a fever.
distractors: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
She stayed at home because she had a fever.
She stayed in bed because she had a cough.

sentences.fr: Tu dois boire beaucoup d’eau quand tu as de la fièvre.
sentences.en: You have to drink a lot of water when you have a fever.
distractors: You have to drink a lot of tea when you have a fever.
You can drink a lot of water when you have a fever.
We have to drink a lot of water when we have a fever.

sentences.fr: Je me suis réveillé à six heures et demie ce matin.
sentences.en: I woke up at half past six this morning.
distractors: I woke up at half past seven this morning.
I woke up at half past six this evening.
I went to bed at half past six this morning.

sentences.fr: Mon frère fait du sport trois fois par semaine.
sentences.en: My brother plays sports three times a week.
distractors: My sister plays sports three times a week.
My brother plays sports twice a week.
My brother plays sports three times a month.

gloss.en: does (faire); faire du sport = to play sports

sentences.fr: Est-ce que la pharmacie est ouverte le dimanche matin ?
sentences.en: Is the pharmacy open on Sunday morning?
distractors: Is the pharmacy open on Saturday morning?
Is the bakery open on Sunday morning?
Is the pharmacy open on Sunday evening?

sentences.fr: Le pharmacien m’a expliqué comment prendre ces comprimés.
sentences.en: The pharmacist explained to me how to take these tablets.
distractors: The pharmacist explained to me when to take these tablets.
The doctor explained to me how to take these tablets.
The pharmacist asked me how to take these tablets.

sentences.fr: Nous n’avons pas dormi de la nuit à cause du bruit.
sentences.en: We did not sleep all night because of the noise.
distractors: We did not sleep all night because of the heat.
They did not sleep all night because of the noise.
We did not sleep all evening because of the noise.

sentences.fr: Quand j’étais petit, je tombais souvent malade en hiver.
sentences.en: When I was little, I often got sick in winter.
distractors: When I was little, I rarely got sick in winter.
When I was little, I often got sick in summer.
When my brother was little, he often got sick in winter.

gloss.en: used to fall; used to become (tomber)

sentences.fr: Elle s’est cassé la jambe pendant un match de foot.
sentences.en: She broke her leg during a football match.
distractors: She broke her arm during a football match.
He broke his leg during a football match.
She broke her leg after a football match.

sentences.fr: Depuis deux jours, il tousse et il a mal à la gorge.
sentences.en: For two days he has been coughing and his throat hurts.
distractors: For three days he has been coughing and his throat hurts.
For two days she has been coughing and her throat hurts.
For two days he has been coughing and his ears hurt.

gloss.en: pain (avoir mal à la gorge = to have a sore throat)

sentences.fr: Le médecin lui a dit de se reposer jusqu’à lundi.
sentences.en: The doctor told him to rest until Monday.
distractors: The doctor told him to rest until Tuesday.
The nurse told him to rest until Monday.
The doctor told him to work until Monday.

sentences.fr: Vous prendrez ce sirop matin et soir pendant une semaine.
sentences.en: You will take this syrup morning and evening for a week.
distractors: You will take this syrup morning and evening for a month.
You will take this syrup morning and evening for three days.
I will take this syrup morning and evening for a week.

sentences.fr: Je n’ai jamais eu la grippe, mais j’ai souvent des rhumes.
sentences.en: I have never had the flu, but I often get colds.
distractors: I have already had the flu, but I often get colds.
He has never had the flu, but he often gets colds.
I have never had the flu, but I rarely get colds.

sentences.fr: Est-ce que tu as pris ta température ce matin ?
sentences.en: Did you take your temperature this morning?
distractors: Did you take your temperature this evening?
Did he take his temperature this morning?
Did you take your medicine this morning?

sentences.fr: Les urgences sont ouvertes vingt-quatre heures sur vingt-quatre.
sentences.en: The emergency department is open twenty-four hours a day.
distractors: The emergency department is open twelve hours a day.
The pharmacy is open twenty-four hours a day.

sentences.fr: Ma sœur est infirmière à l’hôpital depuis cinq ans.
sentences.en: My sister has been a nurse at the hospital for five years.
distractors: My sister has been a nurse at the hospital for four years.
My brother has been a nurse at the hospital for five years.
My sister has been a nurse at the pharmacy for five years.

sentences.fr: Il s’est endormi devant la télévision avant dix heures.
sentences.en: He fell asleep in front of the television before ten.
distractors: He fell asleep in front of the television after ten.
She fell asleep in front of the television before ten.
He fell asleep in front of the computer before ten.

sentences.fr: On a marché pendant deux heures et maintenant j’ai mal aux pieds.
sentences.en: We walked for two hours and now my feet hurt.
distractors: We walked for two hours and now my legs hurt.
We walked for three hours and now my feet hurt.
We ran for two hours and now my feet hurt.

gloss.en: pain (avoir mal aux pieds = to have sore feet)

sentences.fr: Le rendez-vous est le quinze mars à quatorze heures.
sentences.en: The appointment is on the fifteenth of March at two in the afternoon.
distractors: The appointment is on the fifteenth of May at two in the afternoon.
The appointment is on the fifth of March at two in the afternoon.
The appointment is on the fifteenth of March at four in the afternoon.

sentences.fr: Ne mange pas trop de sucre si tu veux rester en forme.
sentences.en: Do not eat too much sugar if you want to stay in shape.
distractors: Do not eat too much salt if you want to stay in shape.
Eat a lot of sugar if you want to stay in shape.
Do not eat too much sugar if he wants to stay in shape.

sentences.fr: Elle prend un cours de yoga le jeudi soir.
sentences.en: She takes a yoga class on Thursday evenings.
distractors: She takes a yoga class on Tuesday evenings.
She takes a yoga class on Thursday mornings.
He takes a yoga class on Thursday evenings.

sentences.fr: J’ai attendu le médecin plus d’une heure dans la salle d’attente.
sentences.en: I waited for the doctor more than an hour in the waiting room.
distractors: I waited for the doctor less than an hour in the waiting room.
I waited for the nurse more than an hour in the waiting room.
I waited for the doctor more than a day in the waiting room.

sentences.fr: Mes parents se couchent tôt parce qu’ils se lèvent à cinq heures.
sentences.en: My parents go to bed early because they get up at five.
distractors: My parents go to bed late because they get up at five.
My parents go to bed early because they get up at nine.
My neighbors go to bed early because they get up at five.

sentences.fr: Le matin, je cours trente minutes au parc près de chez moi.
sentences.en: In the morning I run for thirty minutes in the park near my home.
distractors: In the morning I run for thirteen minutes in the park near my home.
In the evening I run for thirty minutes in the park near my home.
In the morning I walk for thirty minutes in the park near my home.

sentences.fr: Hier soir, j’ai pris un comprimé et la douleur a disparu.
sentences.en: Last night I took a tablet and the pain went away.
distractors: Last night I took two tablets and the pain went away.
Last night I took a tablet and the pain got worse.
This morning I took a tablet and the pain went away.

sentences.fr: Tu te sens mieux qu’hier ?
sentences.en: Do you feel better than yesterday?
distractors: Do you feel worse than yesterday?
Does she feel better than yesterday?
Do you feel better than this morning?

sentences.fr: Il n’y a plus de sirop à la pharmacie du quartier.
sentences.en: There is no more syrup at the neighborhood pharmacy.
distractors: There is still syrup at the neighborhood pharmacy.
There is no more syrup at the hospital pharmacy.
There is no more soap at the neighborhood pharmacy.

gloss.en: there is no more; there is none left

sentences.fr: Si tu as encore mal demain, appelle le médecin.
sentences.en: If it still hurts tomorrow, call the doctor.
distractors: If it still hurts tonight, call the doctor.
If it still hurts tomorrow, call the pharmacist.
If it stops hurting tomorrow, call the doctor.

gloss.en: pain (avoir mal = to be in pain)

sentences.fr: Elle a passé une semaine à l’hôpital après son opération.
sentences.en: She spent a week in the hospital after her operation.
distractors: She spent a month in the hospital after her operation.
She spent a week in the hospital before her operation.
He spent a week in the hospital after his operation.

sentences.fr: Mon grand-père marche lentement, mais il sort tous les jours.
sentences.en: My grandfather walks slowly, but he goes out every day.
distractors: My grandfather walks quickly, but he goes out every day.
My grandmother walks slowly, but she goes out every day.
My grandfather walks slowly, but he goes out every week.

sentences.fr: Je me brosse les dents avant de me coucher.
sentences.en: I brush my teeth before going to bed.
distractors: I brush my teeth after getting up.
He brushes his teeth before going to bed.
I brush my teeth before eating.

sentences.fr: Le samedi, nous faisons du vélo au bord de la rivière.
sentences.en: On Saturdays we go cycling by the river.
distractors: On Sundays we go cycling by the river.
On Saturdays we go swimming by the river.
On Saturdays they go cycling by the river.

gloss.en: do (faire); faire du vélo = to cycle

sentences.fr: Mon fils tousse depuis hier soir et je suis inquiète.
sentences.en: My son has been coughing since last night and I am worried.
distractors: My daughter has been coughing since last night and I am worried.
My son has been coughing since this morning and I am worried.
My son has been sleeping since last night and I am worried.

sentences.fr: Le cours de natation commence à neuf heures et dure une heure.
sentences.en: The swimming class starts at nine and lasts an hour.
distractors: The swimming class starts at nine and lasts two hours.
The swimming class starts at ten and lasts an hour.
The dance class starts at nine and lasts an hour.

sentences.fr: Nous avons annulé notre rendez-vous parce que la voiture est tombée en panne.
sentences.en: We cancelled our appointment because the car broke down.
distractors: We cancelled our appointment because the bus broke down.
They cancelled their appointment because the car broke down.
We changed our appointment because the car broke down.

sentences.fr: Elle dort mal quand elle boit du café le soir.
sentences.en: She sleeps badly when she drinks coffee in the evening.
distractors: She sleeps badly when she drinks tea in the evening.
She sleeps well when she drinks coffee in the evening.
He sleeps badly when he drinks coffee in the evening.

sentences.fr: Vous devez arrêter de fumer pour protéger vos poumons.
sentences.en: You must stop smoking to protect your lungs.
distractors: You must stop smoking to protect your heart.
He must stop smoking to protect his lungs.
You can stop smoking to protect your lungs.

sentences.fr: Le dentiste m’a arraché une dent la semaine dernière.
sentences.en: The dentist pulled out one of my teeth last week.
distractors: The dentist pulled out two of my teeth last week.
The dentist pulled out one of my teeth last month.
The doctor pulled out one of my teeth last week.

gloss.en: pulled out (arracher); m’a arraché une dent = pulled out a tooth of mine

sentences.fr: Combien de fois par jour faut-il prendre ce médicament ?
sentences.en: How many times a day do you have to take this medicine?
distractors: How many times a week do you have to take this medicine?
How many times a day do you have to take this syrup?
How many times a day can you take this medicine?

sentences.fr: Après l’opération, il ne pouvait plus lever le bras droit.
sentences.en: After the operation, he could no longer lift his right arm.
distractors: After the operation, he could no longer lift his left arm.
After the operation, he could still lift his right arm.
Before the operation, he could no longer lift his right arm.

sentences.fr: Ce matin, la salle d’attente était pleine de patients fatigués.
sentences.en: This morning the waiting room was full of tired patients.
distractors: This morning the waiting room was full of tired children.
This evening the waiting room was full of tired patients.
This morning the waiting room was full of impatient patients.

sentences.fr: Je prendrai rendez-vous chez le kinésithérapeute la semaine prochaine.
sentences.en: I will make an appointment with the physiotherapist next week.
distractors: I will make an appointment with the dentist next week.
I will make an appointment with the physiotherapist this week.
She will make an appointment with the physiotherapist next week.

sentences.fr: Elles se sont inscrites à un cours de danse le mercredi.
sentences.en: They signed up for a dance class on Wednesdays.
distractors: They signed up for a dance class on Thursdays.
They signed up for a singing class on Wednesdays.
She signed up for a dance class on Wednesdays.

sentences.fr: Mon médecin est plus gentil que l’ancien, mais il parle vite.
sentences.en: My doctor is kinder than the previous one, but he speaks fast.
distractors: My doctor is kinder than the previous one, but he speaks softly.
My doctor is less kind than the previous one, but he speaks fast.
My dentist is kinder than the previous one, but he speaks fast.

gloss.en: the previous one; the former one

sentences.fr: Est-ce qu’il y a un médecin qui parle anglais dans ce quartier ?
sentences.en: Is there a doctor who speaks English in this neighborhood?
distractors: Is there a doctor who speaks Spanish in this neighborhood?
Is there a pharmacist who speaks English in this neighborhood?
Is there a doctor who speaks English in this village?

sentences.fr: Ne bouge pas ton poignet pendant trois jours, d’accord ?
sentences.en: Do not move your wrist for three days, okay?
distractors: Do not move your ankle for three days, okay?
Do not move your wrist for three weeks, okay?
Move your wrist for three days, okay?

sentences.fr: À quelle heure est-ce que le cabinet ferme le vendredi ?
sentences.en: What time does the medical office close on Fridays?
distractors: What time does the medical office open on Fridays?
What time does the medical office close on Saturdays?
What time does the pharmacy close on Fridays?

lines.speaker: Le médecin
lines.fr: Bonjour Camille, qu’est-ce qui ne va pas ?
lines.en: Hello Camille, what is wrong?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: J’ai mal à la gorge depuis quatre jours et je tousse la nuit.
lines.en: I have had a sore throat for four days and I cough at night.

lines.speaker: Le médecin
lines.fr: Vous avez de la fièvre ?
lines.en: Do you have a fever?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Ce matin, j’avais trente-huit degrés.
lines.en: This morning I had a temperature of thirty-eight.

lines.speaker: Le médecin
lines.fr: Ce n’est pas grave. Reposez-vous et buvez beaucoup d’eau.
lines.en: It is nothing serious. Rest and drink a lot of water.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.fr: Je peux aller travailler demain ?
lines.en: Can I go to work tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Le médecin
lines.fr: Restez chez vous deux jours, puis revenez si ça continue.
lines.en: Stay at home for two days, then come back if it goes on.

questions.question: How long has Camille had a sore throat?
questions.explanation: She says: J’ai mal à la gorge depuis quatre jours.

questions.question: What was Camille’s temperature this morning?
questions.explanation: Ce matin, j’avais trente-huit degrés.

questions.question: What does the doctor tell Camille to do?
choices: Rest and drink a lot of water
questions.explanation: Reposez-vous et buvez beaucoup d’eau.

questions.question: When may Camille go back to work?
questions.explanation: Restez chez vous deux jours — she must stay home for two days first.

gloss.en: is not going well; is wrong (aller)
pain (avoir mal à la gorge = to have a sore throat)

lines.speaker: Le pharmacien
lines.fr: Bonjour, vous avez une ordonnance ?
lines.en: Hello, do you have a prescription?

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.fr: Oui, voilà. C’est pour ma fille, elle a la grippe.
lines.en: Yes, here it is. It is for my daughter, she has the flu.

lines.speaker: Le pharmacien
lines.fr: D’accord. Ce sirop, trois fois par jour, après les repas.
lines.en: All right. This syrup, three times a day, after meals.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.fr: Pendant combien de temps ?
lines.en: For how long?

lines.speaker: Le pharmacien
lines.fr: Pendant cinq jours. Si la fièvre continue, appelez le médecin.
lines.en: For five days. If the fever continues, call the doctor.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.fr: Merci. Ça fait combien ?
lines.en: Thank you. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Le pharmacien
lines.fr: Huit euros vingt, s’il vous plaît.
lines.en: Eight euros twenty, please.

questions.question: Who is the medicine for?
questions.explanation: C’est pour ma fille, elle a la grippe.

questions.question: How should the syrup be taken?
choices: Three times a day, after meals
Three times a day, before meals
questions.explanation: Ce sirop, trois fois par jour, après les repas.

questions.question: How long should the treatment last?
questions.explanation: Pendant cinq jours.

questions.question: What should Louis do if the fever does not go away?
questions.explanation: Si la fièvre continue, appelez le médecin.

lines.speaker: La secrétaire
lines.fr: Cabinet du docteur Meyer, bonjour.
lines.en: Doctor Meyer’s office, hello.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.fr: Bonjour, je voudrais un rendez-vous, s’il vous plaît.
lines.en: Hello, I would like an appointment, please.

lines.speaker: La secrétaire
lines.fr: Mardi dix-sept à onze heures, ça vous va ?
lines.en: Tuesday the seventeenth at eleven, does that suit you?

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.fr: Je travaille le mardi matin. Vous avez quelque chose le soir ?
lines.en: I work on Tuesday mornings. Do you have something in the evening?

lines.speaker: La secrétaire
lines.fr: Alors jeudi dix-neuf, à dix-huit heures trente.
lines.en: Then Thursday the nineteenth, at half past six in the evening.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.fr: Parfait. C’est pour mon fils, il a huit ans.
lines.en: Perfect. It is for my son, he is eight years old.

questions.question: Why does Nadia refuse the first appointment?
choices: She is away on the seventeenth
She does not like that doctor
questions.explanation: Je travaille le mardi matin.

questions.question: When is the appointment finally set?
choices: Thursday the nineteenth at half past six
questions.explanation: Alors jeudi dix-neuf, à dix-huit heures trente.

questions.question: Who is the appointment for?
questions.explanation: C’est pour mon fils, il a huit ans.

questions.question: How old is the patient?
questions.explanation: il a huit ans — the other numbers are the time and the date.

gloss.en: has (avoir); avoir huit ans = to be eight years old

lines.fr: Salut Théo, je ne viendrai pas au bureau aujourd’hui.
lines.en: Hi Théo, I will not come to the office today.

lines.fr: J’ai attrapé la grippe de mon fils et j’ai de la fièvre depuis hier.
lines.en: I caught the flu from my son and I have had a fever since yesterday.

lines.fr: Je vais rester au lit et je prendrai rendez-vous chez le médecin ce soir.
lines.en: I am going to stay in bed and I will make an appointment with the doctor this evening.

lines.fr: Peux-tu annuler la réunion de quatorze heures et prévenir Sophie ?
lines.en: Can you cancel the two o’clock meeting and let Sophie know?

lines.fr: Je reviendrai lundi si ça va mieux. Merci beaucoup !
lines.en: I will come back on Monday if things are better. Thank you very much!

questions.question: Why is the writer staying at home?
choices: He caught the flu from his son
His son is ill and needs him
He has an appointment at the office
questions.explanation: J’ai attrapé la grippe de mon fils et j’ai de la fièvre depuis hier.

questions.question: What does he ask Théo to do?
choices: Cancel the two o’clock meeting and tell Sophie
Move the meeting to the evening
questions.explanation: Peux-tu annuler la réunion de quatorze heures et prévenir Sophie ?

questions.question: When will he make the doctor’s appointment?
questions.explanation: je prendrai rendez-vous chez le médecin ce soir.

questions.question: When does he plan to come back to work?
choices: On Monday, if he feels better
questions.explanation: Je reviendrai lundi si ça va mieux.

gloss.en: to let someone know; to warn

lines.fr: Le sommeil est aussi important que le sport pour la santé.
lines.en: Sleep is as important as sport for your health.

lines.fr: Un adulte doit dormir entre sept et huit heures par nuit.
lines.en: An adult should sleep between seven and eight hours a night.

lines.fr: Le soir, évitez le café et les écrans avant de vous coucher.
lines.en: In the evening, avoid coffee and screens before going to bed.

lines.fr: Si vous vous réveillez souvent la nuit, parlez-en à votre médecin.
lines.en: If you often wake up at night, talk about it to your doctor.

questions.question: What does the text compare sleep with?
questions.explanation: Le sommeil est aussi important que le sport.

questions.question: How long should an adult sleep?
questions.explanation: Un adulte doit dormir entre sept et huit heures par nuit.

questions.question: What should you avoid in the evening?
questions.explanation: évitez le café et les écrans avant de vous coucher.

questions.question: What should you do if you often wake up at night?
choices: Talk to your doctor about it
questions.explanation: Si vous vous réveillez souvent la nuit, parlez-en à votre médecin.

lines.speaker: Yasmine
lines.fr: Tu viens courir avec moi samedi matin ?
lines.en: Are you coming running with me on Saturday morning?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Je ne peux pas, je joue au foot le samedi.
lines.en: I cannot, I play football on Saturdays.

lines.speaker: Yasmine
lines.fr: Dimanche, alors ? On peut courir une heure au parc.
lines.en: On Sunday, then? We can run for an hour in the park.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: D’accord, mais pas trop tôt. Neuf heures, ça va ?
lines.en: All right, but not too early. Nine o’clock, is that okay?

lines.speaker: Yasmine
lines.fr: Parfait. La dernière fois, j’ai eu mal aux genoux pendant deux jours.
lines.en: Perfect. Last time my knees hurt for two days.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Il faut marcher cinq minutes avant de courir.
lines.en: You have to walk for five minutes before running.

questions.question: Why does Karim say no to Saturday?
questions.explanation: Je ne peux pas, je joue au foot le samedi.

questions.question: What do they finally agree on?
questions.explanation: Dimanche, alors ? … Neuf heures, ça va ?

questions.question: What happened to Yasmine last time?
choices: Her knees hurt for two days
questions.explanation: La dernière fois, j’ai eu mal aux genoux pendant deux jours.

questions.question: What does Karim advise before running?
questions.explanation: Il faut marcher cinq minutes avant de courir.

gloss.en: pain (avoir mal aux genoux = to have sore knees)

lines.fr: Cette semaine, j’ai très mal dormi.
lines.en: This week I slept very badly.

lines.fr: Lundi et mardi, j’ai travaillé jusqu’à minuit sur un rapport.
lines.en: On Monday and Tuesday I worked until midnight on a report.

lines.fr: Mercredi matin, j’étais si fatiguée que j’ai oublié mon rendez-vous chez le dentiste.
lines.en: On Wednesday morning I was so tired that I forgot my appointment with the dentist.

lines.fr: Le soir, je me suis couchée à neuf heures et j’ai dormi douze heures.
lines.en: In the evening I went to bed at nine and slept twelve hours.

lines.fr: Depuis jeudi, je vais beaucoup mieux.
lines.en: Since Thursday I have been feeling much better.

questions.question: What kept the writer up on Monday and Tuesday?
choices: A report she had to work on
questions.explanation: Lundi et mardi, j’ai travaillé jusqu’à minuit sur un rapport.

questions.question: What did she forget on Wednesday morning?
questions.explanation: j’ai oublié mon rendez-vous chez le dentiste.

questions.question: How long did she sleep on Wednesday night?
questions.explanation: je me suis couchée à neuf heures et j’ai dormi douze heures — nine is the time she went to bed.

questions.question: How has she felt since Thursday?
questions.explanation: Depuis jeudi, je vais beaucoup mieux.

lines.speaker: L’infirmière
lines.fr: Qu’est-ce qui s’est passé ?
lines.en: What happened?

lines.speaker: Hugo
lines.fr: Je suis tombé de vélo ce matin, ma cheville est très enflée.
lines.en: I fell off my bike this morning, my ankle is very swollen.

lines.speaker: L’infirmière
lines.fr: Vous pouvez marcher ?
lines.en: Can you walk?

lines.speaker: Hugo
lines.fr: Un peu, mais ça fait très mal quand je pose le pied.
lines.en: A little, but it hurts a lot when I put my foot down.

lines.speaker: L’infirmière
lines.fr: On va faire une radio. Asseyez-vous, le médecin arrive dans dix minutes.
lines.en: We are going to take an X-ray. Sit down, the doctor is coming in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Hugo
lines.fr: Merci. J’ai un match de foot dimanche…
lines.en: Thank you. I have a football match on Sunday…

lines.speaker: L’infirmière
lines.fr: Oubliez le match : il faut du repos.
lines.en: Forget the match: you need rest.

questions.question: How did Hugo hurt himself?
choices: He was hurt in a football match
questions.explanation: Je suis tombé de vélo ce matin.

questions.question: What does Hugo say about walking?
choices: He can walk a little, but it hurts when he puts his foot down
He can walk without any pain
questions.explanation: Un peu, mais ça fait très mal quand je pose le pied.

questions.question: What happens next?
choices: An X-ray, and the doctor comes in ten minutes
He goes home with a bandage
questions.explanation: On va faire une radio. … le médecin arrive dans dix minutes.

questions.question: What does the nurse say about Sunday’s match?
choices: He can play if the ankle is better
He must forget it and rest
questions.explanation: Oubliez le match : il faut du repos.

gloss.en: makes (faire); ça fait mal = it hurts

lines.fr: La pharmacie du centre sera fermée du douze au quinze août.
lines.en: The town center pharmacy will be closed from the twelfth to the fifteenth of August.

lines.fr: Pendant ces quatre jours, la pharmacie de la gare restera ouverte.
lines.en: During those four days, the station pharmacy will stay open.

lines.fr: Elle ouvre tous les jours de huit heures à vingt heures, sauf le dimanche.
lines.en: It opens every day from eight in the morning to eight in the evening, except on Sundays.

lines.fr: Pour une urgence la nuit, appelez le quinze.
lines.en: For an emergency at night, call fifteen.

questions.question: When is the town center pharmacy closed?
choices: From the twelfth to the fifteenth of August
From the fifteenth to the twentieth of August
questions.explanation: La pharmacie du centre sera fermée du douze au quinze août.

questions.question: Which pharmacy stays open during those days?
choices: The one in the town center
questions.explanation: la pharmacie de la gare restera ouverte.

questions.question: On which day is that pharmacy closed?
questions.explanation: Elle ouvre tous les jours … sauf le dimanche.

questions.question: What should you do in an emergency at night?
choices: Wait until eight in the morning
questions.explanation: Pour une urgence la nuit, appelez le quinze.
